item.title: TrendForce Warns DRAM Contract Prices May Turn Down in 2028
item.description:
TrendForce says US political shifts, rising financing difficulty for Neocloud players and export controls are clouding DRAM demand, prompting supply chains to revisit 2027-2028 production plans and slightly cooling procurement momentum. With major DRAM makers still shipping significantly more capacity, conventional DRAM contract prices are seen flat in H2 2027 and falling in 2028 under the base case, with a possible turning point as early as Q4 2027 in the pessimistic scenario.

原文标题：TrendForce 预警 DRAM 合约价 2028 年转跌风险升温

Why it matters：这是判断 AI 算力与存储周期拐点的关键前瞻信号，直接影响服务器与 GPU 集群的成本预期。

item.title: Kaspersky Warns AI Agents Are Becoming Hackers' New Weapon
item.description:
Kaspersky CEO Eugene Kaspersky says AI will not destroy humanity in the near term, but it has already become a major cyberattack tool, arriving far faster than he expected. He warns that agentic AI, once granted sufficient permissions, could autonomously execute attack chains, pressuring traditional defenses while lowering the cost and barrier to entry for attackers.

原文标题：卡巴斯基警告 AI 智能体正成为黑客新武器

Why it matters：来自头部安全厂商掌门人的一线判断，点明智能体权限失控这一现实风险，对关注 AI 安全落地的读者有参考价值。

item.title: Survey Finds Nearly 80% of Retail Firms Have Piloted AI Agents
item.description:
The China Chain Store & Franchise Association and Deloitte China released a 2026 whitepaper on generative AI in retail, finding that nearly 80% of respondents' companies have deployed AI agents, with 23% at scale and 56% in limited pilots. Scaling remains the key challenge, and 47% cite uncertain returns as the top barrier, overtaking concerns about use-case selection and output reliability.

原文标题：调研称近八成零售企业已试水 AI 智能体

Why it matters：这份行业白皮书给出了零售业智能体渗透率与落地障碍的一手调研数据，对判断企业级 Agent 商业化节奏有参考价值。

item.title: Zhihu Partners with DeepSeek on Community Content Retrieval
item.description:
Zhihu announced it will supply DeepSeek with retrieval access to its community Q&A, articles, trending lists and topic discussions via its data open platform, spanning tech, finance and other domains. The integration covers DeepSeek's web and mobile apps, showing Zhihu source labels, titles, summaries and creator info with one-click links to the original posts. The deal follows Zhihu's indirect acquisition of a low single-digit stake in DeepSeek through an intermediary entity, which CEO Zhou Yuan called a long-term strategic decision.

item.title: Palo Alto CEO Warns AI Is Cracking Human-Proof Vulnerabilities
item.description:

item.title: Musk Says AI and Robots Will Demand Far More Bandwidth Than Humans
item.description:
Elon Musk argued in an interview that future bandwidth demand will be driven mainly by superintelligence and robots, which could communicate at trillions of bits per second versus roughly 100 bits per second for peak human speech. The claim points to long-term expansion of compute and network infrastructure but remains a qualitative forecast without technical detail or supporting data.

item.title: Audit Finds MiniMax Opened Private Links Hidden in User Prompts
item.description:
US security firm Dragos planted trap links and fake logins in nearly 2 million prompts sent to multiple AI services to test whether providers secretly read or passed on customer data. Only links in prompts routed to MiniMax's servers were opened days later by unknown parties, even when users had requested no storage; after the scraping appeared to stop on October 22, a git client tried to clone private code repositories referenced in MiniMax-bound prompts. MiniMax says its security system automatically collected and opened links for threat detection without retaining full content, while Atlas Cloud stopped forwarding requests to MiniMax and OpenRouter removed three providers and tightened its data privacy rules.

原文标题：安全审计曝 MiniMax 私自打开用户提示词中的私密链接

Why it matters：第三方安全审计直指大模型服务商的数据处理边界，并已引发下游平台断供与隐私规则收紧，对评估 API 供应商风险有直接参考价值。

item.title: Nscale Says It Has Enough Capital to Delay $35B IPO
item.description:
Nscale CEO Josh Payne told staff the UK data centre operator has enough capital to stay private, casting doubt on its planned $35B IPO and promising only to list as soon as possible. The company expects a net loss of nearly $1.7B for the nine months to September on revenue of just $307M, and says it will need additional financing in 2027. Listed peers CoreWeave and Nebius fell 24% and 43% in a month, signaling a poor market window.

原文标题：Nscale 称资金充足暂缓 350 亿美元 IPO

Why it matters：AI 算力基础设施大额 IPO 生变，叠加巨额亏损与同业估值回调，是观察算力泡沫与融资环境的关键信号。

item.title: Ladybird Browser Ships First Alpha With Fully In-House Engine
item.description:
After four years of building a browser engine from scratch, the Ladybird project released its first downloadable alpha on November 23, offering prebuilt macOS and Linux packages with automatic updates instead of requiring users to compile from source. Both its rendering engine and LibJS JavaScript engine are written from the ground up rather than forked from Blink or Gecko.

原文标题：Ladybird 浏览器首个 Alpha 版发布 引擎完全自研

Why it matters：这是独立浏览器引擎生态的重要里程碑，为关注开源基础设施与 Web 平台多样性的读者提供实质进展。

item.title: JetBrains Survey of 29,000 Developers Finds 96% Use AI at Work
item.description:
JetBrains' tenth annual Developer Ecosystem report, based on 28,945 developers worldwide, finds 96% of employed developers use at least one AI tool at work, with 55% reporting higher creativity but 46% feeling less ownership of code. Claude Code leads tool usage at 39%, ahead of GitHub Copilot at 21%, and over half of coding-agent users say agents handled more than 60% of their development tasks last month.

原文标题：JetBrains 调查近 3 万开发者 96% 已在工作中使用 AI

Why it matters：近 3 万样本的年度开发者生态调查，量化了 AI 编码工具与智能体的真实渗透率及开发者心态变化，具备行业基准价值。

item.title: 腾讯开源 DFly2 投机解码器 吞吐提升 81%
item.description:
腾讯开源 DFly2，一种面向稀疏注意力大模型的投机解码器，通过复用目标模型各层的 KV 缓存与 top-k 索引位置，草稿模型无需自建 KV 缓存、跳过预填充，任意上下文长度下每个草稿 token 最多读取约 2K 个 key。在 DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash 上平均接受长度达 4.12（DSpark 为 3.81），两组 64K 场景下服务吞吐分别提升 62% 与 81%。局限在于仅适用于自带稀疏索引器的目标模型，通用任务上相对 DSpark 增益仅 3.9%。

Why it matters：稀疏注意力模型的高效推理是当前工程热点，该方案以零额外 KV 显存换取显著吞吐提升，且已落地 vLLM/SGLang 并开源训练代码。
